instr: Procedures: carry out a list of steps in order by clicking the step buttons; if another task interrupts you, go back and continue where you left off.
clue: Carry out the procedure: click the step buttons in the order of the list (or press their number keys). Do each step once; nothing will show which steps are done. Sometimes a different task will interrupt you: say whether each number is even or odd. When the procedure comes back, continue from where you stopped. Press Start when ready.
interrupt_hint: Left arrow = even, right arrow = odd
